# `jouet cost`

- **Usage:** `jouet cost [--min <DUR>] [--sequences] [SUBCOMMAND]`

Show what builds, tests and lints cost here, from timings kept in git notes

`jouet test` and the hooks time each build, test and lint run and keep it as a git note on HEAD under refs/notes/jouet-cost (`[cost] record` in the config file or JOUET_COST_RECORD turns it off). This lists each command, or each family of commands such as one e2e test, costliest first, read from up to 200 first-parent commits back. Timings from other machines, such as CI's, are scaled to this one: by the median ratio of this machine's time to theirs over the commands timed in both places, or shown as they are when there are none. CI keeps its timings with `jouet cost push` after its runs; `jouet cost fetch` brings them here.

With [cost] sequences = true (JOUET_COST_SEQUENCES=1), `jouet test` records local start and finish observations for each recognized check in an identified agent session. `--sequences` shows the second check's median duration after the first for at least three adjacent recorded pairs in the same session and worktree. Other work and cache changes may intervene; these observations do not measure savings or prove cache reuse.

## Flags
- **`--min <DUR>`** — List only the commands estimated to take at least DUR, such as 30s
- **`--sequences`** — Show opt-in local observations of successive recorded checks
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
